data.one_liner: Detect rooting, hooking tools, emulators, debug mode and store installation on Android/iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to check if the device is rooted, running on an emulator, using hooking frameworks like Frida or Xposed, or if the app is in debug mode. It can also enforce security actions such as exiting the process or uninstalling the app.
use_when: You need to protect a Flutter app from tampering or running on compromised devices
You want to enforce security policies like terminating the app on rooted or emulated environments
avoid_when: You only need basic device info without security checks
You target platforms other than Android/iOS
strengths: Simple API with async boolean checks
Built‑in options to exit or uninstall the app automatically
Supports screenshot prevention and recent‑apps hiding
weaknesses: Limited to Android and iOS only
Security checks can be bypassed by advanced attackers
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, run flutter pub get, and for Android add ProGuard/R8 keep rules as documented; iOS requires no extra steps.
